sentences.en: It is necessary to have a healthy disdain for wealth.
sentences.zh: 有必要对财富保持健康的鄙视。

sentences.en: She laughed with poorly disguised disdain in her voice.
sentences.zh: 她笑得毫不掩饰地带着鄙视。

sentences.en: I enjoyed myself exceedingly, not disdaining the supper, everything being most delicious.
sentences.zh: 我玩得很开心，没有鄙视晚餐，因为一切都非常美味。

senses.zh: 鄙视 - 不屑于做, 不愿意做
